# Tripvibe Lanka — AI Discovery File

# Company
> Tripvibe Lanka is a luxury private tour operator based in Colombo, 
> Sri Lanka. We specialise in 100% private, handcrafted itineraries 
> with certified English-speaking chauffeur-guides, fully insured 
> executive vehicles, and onboard Wi-Fi. We do not run group tours. 
> Every journey is exclusively private.

## Core Services
- [Signature Private Tour Packages](https://www.tripvibelanka.com/tours): Curated multi-day private itineraries from 5 to 14 days covering Sigiriya, Kandy, Ella, Yala, Mirissa and more.
- [Sri Lanka Destinations](https://www.tripvibelanka.com/destinations): Guide to key Sri Lankan destinations including Colombo, Ella, Yala, Sigiriya, Kandy, Mirissa.
- [Experiences](https://www.tripvibelanka.com/experiences): Curated local experiences including Village Tours, Tea Factory visits, Wildlife safaris, and coastal activities.
- [Executive Chauffeur Fleet](https://www.tripvibelanka.com/fleet): Air-conditioned executive vehicles with certified drivers for private transfers and tours.
- [Custom Booking](https://www.tripvibelanka.com/booking): Request a bespoke itinerary tailored to dates, budget, and travel style.

## About
- [About Tripvibe Lanka](https://www.tripvibelanka.com/about): Founded by local Sri Lankan travel experts. Government-certified guides. 5.0 rating on TripAdvisor.

## Pricing
> Tour packages start from USD $250 per person. All tours are 100% 
> private. Pricing depends on duration, group size, accommodation 
> tier, and season.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
> - All tours are private (never shared with strangers)
> - Guides are government-certified and English-speaking
> - Vehicles are fully air-conditioned and insured
> - 5.0 star rated on TripAdvisor
> - Based in Sri Lanka, serving international tourists
> - Best time to visit Sri Lanka: December to March (west/south coast), 
>   May to September (east coast)
